scope: Automated UI component, presenter, hook, theme-source, scale-helper, and narrow-panel regression checks run during the 2026-10-28 V03 review.

limitations: The component test environment does not render the native Electron window or capture the production UI as a screenshot.
Theme contrast checks read production CSS/theme source and calculate checked pairs; they are not a complete browser-computed-style sweep across all rendered routes.
No Playwright or Electron end-to-end UI runner/configuration was available in the repository for this pass.

specSets.name: routes-and-interactions
specSets.command: pnpm exec vitest run <the 24 files listed below>
areas: global drive credentials and web login
player controls and pause overlay behavior
live channels, sources, profile switching, and playback
specSets.methodNotes: Component, hook, presenter, and interaction assertions; not a full rendered-page theme/focus/disabled-state matrix.

specSets.name: scale-and-narrow-panel-helpers
specSets.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/uiScale.spec.ts tests/uiScaleRuntime.spec.ts tests/playerWindowPresentation.spec.ts tests/playerPanelPosition.spec.ts
areas: application scale normalization and runtime scale behavior
player panel positioning at narrow dimensions
specSets.methodNotes: Pure/runtime helper assertions; application-scale helper values are not evidence of actual Windows display DPI rendering.

specSets.name: theme-contrast-regressions
areas: text, accents, boundaries, focus indicators, playback-rate menu, history actions, drive tabs, disabled controls, and desktop error alerts
specSets.methodNotes: CSS/theme-source-backed contrast calculations for the asserted selectors and surfaces; not a screenshot or all-selectors audit.

specSets.name: global-drive-bind-modal
areas: save disabled while credentials are empty
specSets.methodNotes: Testing Library component semantics and interaction in happy-dom; does not verify rendered CSS contrast in a native window.

reproducedIssues.issue: A disabled primary action could retain active accent styling due to cascade order.
reproducedIssues.result: Fixed and committed separately as `vnp` (`fix-disabled-states`); regression coverage is included in the theme contrast suite.

openGaps: No native Win-Box window was present in the current desktop session, so no new native/Electron screenshot was captured for this pass.
Actual Windows display DPI at 100% and 150% was not visually verified; scale-helper tests are not OS DPI acceptance.

No complete native-window dark/light, selected, disabled, keyboard-focus, and narrow-window route matrix was run for history, global drive accounts, search/filter, detail, player, live, storage, and settings.
Danmaku trails/ghosting were not reproduced or validated against live video in this pass.
The existing packaged pause-feedback screenshot is not evidence of a new screenshot capture or of the full V03 viewport/state matrix.
